en: Somebody's knocking at the door. I'll answer it.
The number 13 bus will take you to the hospital.
They celebrated his birthday with a dance party.
zh: 他们举行舞会庆祝他的生日。

en: They misplaced this book under other categories.
zh: 他们把它错放到另一个类别去了。

en: They played a shameful part in the whole affair.
zh: 他们在这一事件中扮演了可耻的角色。

en: As a matter of fact, he was pretending to be ill.
I will speak against anything I know to be wrong.
zh: 我会对所有我认为不对的事情直言不讳。

en: In spite of the heavy rain, she went to the shop.
zh: 尽管下着大雨，她还是去了商店。

en: No matter what happened, he would not say a word.
zh: 不管发生什么事，他也不会说一句话。

en: No one knows the location of the hidden treasure.
zh: 谁也不知道藏宝地点在哪里。

en: The old lady enjoys a quiet life with her family.
zh: 老太太和她的家人安享宁静的生活。

en: The population of the city is close to a million.
zh: 这个城市的人口接近一百万。

en: We are prohibited from smoking on school grounds.
zh: 我们被禁止在校园内抽烟。

en: Growth, however, brings new problems and concerns.
zh: 不过，发展也带来了新的问题和顾虑。

en: He appears to be your friend, but I doubt if he is.
zh: 他似乎是你的朋友，但我怀疑他是否是。

en: I am so full that I would burst with another bite.
zh: 我吃得如此之饱，我感觉我再吃一口肚子就要胀破了。

en: I have two cats. One is white, the other is black.
zh: 我有两只猫，一只是白猫，另一只是黑猫。

en: I'm sorry, these 2 books are 3 days overdue.
zh: 对不起，这两本书已经过期3天了。

en: Jalu had forgotten to fall off his bicycle.
zh: 贾鲁忘记了从自行车上摔下来的事。

en: Manners are quite different from country to country.
Not only did I know her, but I was her best friend.
zh: 我不仅认识她，还是她最好的朋友。

en: The best-known movie awards are academy awards.
zh: 最著名的电影奖是奥斯卡金像奖。

en: We've got to do something about the neighbor's dog!
zh: 我们得对邻居的狗采取点行动了！

en: Will you come and join us for dinner on Sunday?
zh: 星期天来和我们共进晚餐好吗？

en: Do you think people are the company's greatest wealth?
zh: 你认为人是公司最大的财富吗？

en: He thinks of himself as somebody, but we think of him as nobody.
zh: 他自以为了不起，但我们认为他什么都不是。

en: I believe I haven't reached the summit of my career.
zh: 我相信我还没有达到事业的巅峰。

en: It is no matter whether you get there early or late.
zh: 你早到还是晚到都没有关系。

en: It's against the rules to handle the ball in soccer.
zh: 在足球中以手触球就是犯规。

en: The nurse assisted the doctor in the operating room.
zh: 护士在手术室协助医生动手术。

en: What I do on my own time is nobody else's business.
zh: 我在自己的时间里做什么不关别人的事。

en: What I want to do is different from those of others.
zh: 我想做的与其他人不同。

en: You forget to write down the date of your departure.
zh: 你忘了写下离开的日期。

en: I wish I'd known about that rule earlier, she said.
zh: 她说：“我希望早点知道这条规则。”。

en: Could you tell me your secret for a long, happy life?
zh: 你能告诉我长时间地过着快乐的生活的秘诀吗？

en: He holds a position of great responsibility upon him.
zh: 他担任着一个责任重大的职务。

en: It is said he has secret love affairs with two women!
zh: 据说他背地里和两个女人有关系！

en: Number 13 buses run much more frequently, don't they?
zh: 13路公共汽车开得更频繁，不是吗？

en: They are only too delighted to accept the invitation.
zh: 他们非常乐意接受邀请。

en: We are going to have the final examination next week.
zh: 我们下周举行期末考试。

en: And now medical care helps to keep people alive longer.
zh: 现在医疗保健有助于延长人们的寿命。

en: Do you think you'll be able to go to sleep right away?
zh: 你认为你能马上睡觉吗？

en: I am in charge of the company when the manager is out.
zh: 经理不在时，我负责公司。

en: I borrowed a notebook from Tom and I lent it to Mary.
zh: 我从汤姆那儿借了一本笔记本，我又把它借给玛丽了。

en: I'm doing some washing and John is cooking dinner.
zh: 我正在洗衣服，约翰在做晚饭。

en: Were there any exciting incidents during your journey?
zh: 在你的旅途中有什么激动人心的事情吗？

en: As far as policy is concerned, I have to say something.
zh: 就政策而言，我不得不说点什么。

en: Could you tell me what the maximum weight allowance is?
zh: 你能告诉我最大重量限额是多少吗？

en: He came out of the library, a large book under his arm.
zh: 他夹着本厚书，走出了图书馆。

en: The brothers differ from each other in their interests.
Although we can't see these atoms, they really do exist.
zh: 虽然我们看不见原子，但它们的确存在。

en: I am familiar with the casual atmosphere in the company.
zh: 我对公司中这种放松的氛围感到很熟悉。

en: Most people eat, write, and work with their right hands.
zh: 大多数人吃饭，写字，工作都用右手。

en: Only by working hard can we succeed in doing everything.
zh: 只有努力工作，我们才能成功地做每件事。

en: Take it easy, you will be all right in a couple of days.
zh: 别担心，你两天之内就会痊愈的。

en: The Beatles represented part of the spirit of their age.
zh: 甲壳虫乐队代表了他们时代的部分精神。

en: There being no one to help me, I had to do it all alone.
zh: 因为没有人帮助我，我不得不独立完成这项工作。

en: How much clothing does it take to make a skirt for the girl?
zh: 给这个女孩做一条裙子需要多少布？

en: With all these mouths to feed, he didn't know what to do.
zh: 由于有那么多人要供养，他不知道怎么办才好。

en: I forgot to prepare the speech I'm supposed to give today.
zh: 我忘了准备今天的演讲稿。

en: It's supposed to start at 6:30 sharp, but I doubt it will.
zh: 应该在6点半准时开始，但我怀疑它会。

en: On behalf of my company, I would like to welcome you here.
zh: 我代表我的公司欢迎你来到这里。

en: She's been quite different since coming back from America.
zh: 从美国回来之后，她变化很大。

en: Today it is common that women and girls make up in public.
zh: 今天，在公共场所看到妇女和姑娘化妆打扮是很普遍的事。

en: I have to transfer to no. 11 bus, but where is the bus stop?
zh: 我必须换乘11路公共汽车，但是公共汽车站在哪里？

en: I supposed him to be very clever, but he was in fact a fool.
zh: 我以为他很聪明，但实际上他是个傻瓜。

en: The rabbit ran to the woods and did not come back any more.
zh: 兔子跑进了森林再也没有出来了。

en: Tom and Mary congratulated us on the birth of our daughter.
zh: 汤姆和玛丽祝贺我们女儿的出生。

en: I can't help eating sweets whenever they are in my presence.
zh: 每当糖果在我面前时，我都忍不住要吃。

en: I am vacuuming the floor now and have several shirts to iron.
zh: 我正在用吸尘器打扫地板，有几件衬衫要熨。

en: I will love you until the seas run dry and the rocks crumble.
zh: 我将爱你直到海枯石烂。

en: There is a broken small old gray stone bridge over the river.
zh: 河上有一座破旧的灰色小桥。

en: No wonder people say that computers are taking over the world.
zh: 难怪有人说电子计算机正渐渐接管世界。

en: The enormous increase in population will create many problems.
zh: 巨大的人口增长将产生很多问题。

en: There's nothing better for you than plenty of water and sleep.
zh: 没有什么比充足的水和睡眠对你更好的了。

en: You should always depend on yourself rather than someone else.
zh: 你应该永远依靠自己，而不是别人。

en: I would like to express to all of you here our sincere welcome.
zh: 我要向在座的各位表示我们诚挚的欢迎。

en: Many people prefer living in the country to living in the town.
zh: 许多人喜欢住在农村而不喜欢住在城市。

en: Since I'm here, I'd like to try a typical dish of this country.
zh: 既然来了，我想吃这个国家特有的食物。

en: Walking up and down the stairs would beat any exercise machine.
zh: 上下楼梯可比什么健身器都要好。

en: Had it not been for the alarm clock, she wouldn't have been late.
zh: 如果不是因为闹钟不响的话，她就不会迟到了。

en: However, if you work hard, the boss will not be fully satisfied.
zh: 无论你有多努力，老板总不会完全满意。

en: If he had not broken his tooth, he would not be in hospital now.
zh: 如果他没有把牙齿弄坏，他现在就不会住院了。

en: You might as well throw your money away as spend it on gambling.
zh: 你与其把钱花在赌博上，还不如把它扔掉。

en: Can you put me in the picture of the world cup football match?
zh: 你能给我介绍一下世界杯足球赛的情况吗？

en: I'm usually just using search engines to look up information.
zh: 我通常只是用搜索引擎找一些资料。

en: He goes home early every day for fear that his wife would be angry.
zh: 他每天很早就回家，生怕妻子生气。

en: I regret to inform you that we are unable to offer you employment.
zh: 我很遗憾地通知你，我们无法为你提供就业机会。

en: I will continue my learning, though I am tired of learning English.
zh: 我会继续我的学习，虽然我厌倦了学习英语。

en: Li Bai is one of the greatest poets that have ever lived in China.
zh: 李白是中国有史以来最伟大的诗人之一。

en: Many people complain that computers are taking over their jobs.
zh: 许多人抱怨电脑正在接管他们的工作。

en: The cupboards in her kitchen were full of things she did not need.
zh: 她厨房的橱柜里装满了她不需要的东西。

en: What he said did not annoy me much, for I knew he did not mean it.
zh: 他说的话并没有使我很生气，因为我知道他不是那个意思。

en: He asked me some personal questions, but I would never answer them.
zh: 他问了我一些私人问题，但我永远不会回答。

en: I don't care where we go as long as we don't have to stand in line.
zh: 我不在乎我们去哪里，只要我们不必排队。

en: She likes Mike a lot, but she doesn't want to get married so early.
zh: 她喜欢迈克，但她不想那么早就结婚。

en: Why don't you find a job and end this dependence upon your parents?
zh: 你为什么不找份工作，结束对父母的依赖？

en: Will you please try to find out for me what time the train arrives?
zh: 你能帮我查一下火车什么时候到吗？

en: A good knowledge of English will improve your chances of employment.
zh: 良好的英语知识将提高你的就业机会。

en: If she finds out you spilled ink on her coat, she'll blow her stack.
zh: 如果她发现你把墨水洒在她的上衣上，她会大发雷霆的。

en: I would be very grateful for information about entering your college.
zh: 如能提供贵校入学信息，我将不胜感激。

en: Mr. Smith knew Jack didn't look at the others because he was nervous.
zh: 史密斯先生知道杰克不敢看别人是因为紧张。

en: On being introduced to somebody, a British person often shakes hands.
zh: 英国人被介绍给别人的时候常常和对方握握手。

en: I want to take a walk along the river bank, singing my favorite songs.
zh: 我想沿着河岸散步，唱我最喜欢的歌。

en: Many people believe that obesity results from overeating and stress.
zh: 许多人认为超重是由暴饮暴食和压力引起的。

en: Yet all these things, different as they seem, have one thing in common.
zh: 然而，所有这些看起来不同的东西都有一个共同点。

en: All my best memories come back clearly to me, some can even make me cry.
zh: 所有美好的回忆都清晰地浮现在我的脑海里，有些甚至让我哭泣。

en: This is the most wonderful day of my life, because I'm here with you now.
zh: 今天是我一生中最美好的一天，因为我现在和你在一起。

en: When I was young, I'd listen to the radio, waiting for my favorite songs.
zh: 当我年轻的时候，我会听收音机，等待我最喜欢的歌曲。

en: I'm certain he'll go to see the film, because he's bought a ticket.
zh: 我肯定他会去看电影，因为他买了一张票。

en: Unfortunately, you'll have to pay the fine before you check those books out.
zh: 不幸的是，在你借出那些书之前，你必须先付清罚款。

en: Hi! You guys keep talking so loudly that I have to speak at the top of my voice!
zh: 嗨！你们一直这么大声说话，我不得不高声说话！

en: We should not only know the theory but also how to apply it to practice.
zh: 我们不仅要知道理论，还要知道怎样把理论应用于实践。

en: Combining exercise with a diet may be the most effective way to lose weight.
zh: 运动与节食结合也许是减肥最有效的途径。

en: The maximum weight allowance is 60 kilos per traveler, excluding hand luggage.
zh: 每位旅客的最大重量限额为60公斤，手提行李除外。

en: You are just putting on a little weight. I believe you'll get that off easily.
zh: 你只是稍微胖了些。很快就会恢复的。

en: In many countries, more and more companies are replacing people with computers.
zh: 在许多国家有越来越多的公司使用电子计算机来代替人。

en: There are mice next to the refrigerator, under the sink and inside the cupboard!
zh: 冰箱旁边、水槽下面和橱柜里面都有老鼠！
